qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for flywheel to crankshaft bolts on M60/1/M60/2/M62 Manual Transmission?
What torque value should be used for new micro-encapsulated screws on M40/M42/M43/M44/M51 Automatic/M52 Automatic transmissions?
What is the torque specification for new micro-encapsulated screws on all other transmission types?
What important warning is given about flywheel installation?
qa_pairs.answer: Do not install with screw retaining compound. Bolts are a component part of the flywheel. Screw threads oiled.

qa_pairs.question: What section number covers the engine flywheel specifications?
Which transmission types require 120 Nm torque for new micro-encapsulated screws?
Should screw retaining compound be used when installing the flywheel?
qa_pairs.answer: No, do not install with screw retaining compound.

qa_pairs.question: What should be applied to the screw threads during flywheel installation?
qa_pairs.answer: Oil should be applied to screw threads.
